curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can the same wild antics that constantly exasperate Mr. Wilson actually track down a missing fortune before a shady drifter slips away?
curatedMovie.description: Mischievous young Dennis is a constant thorn in the side of his neighbor, Mr. Wilson. When a shady drifter arrives and Wilson's gold coin collection disappears, the boy's relentless antics become unexpectedly useful.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Light, funny, and breezy, pairing steady comic momentum with low-stress family entertainment.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Nick Castle, this lighthearted family comedy turns chaotic neighborhood mischief into a buoyant, briskly paced comic caper with zero viewing friction.
